title: Kenzy and Her Crew

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Well?!?! Did you talk to him? Is he in? Are we getting the band back together?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well?!?! Did you talk to him? Is he in? Are we getting the band back together?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: What do you know of them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you know of them?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa. What did Finn tell you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa. What did Finn tell you?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: What the ever-loving fuck man? Did you even defend me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the ever-loving fuck man? Did you even defend me?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: THAT'S THE ENTIRE PROBLEM!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THAT'S THE ENTIRE PROBLEM!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Help me get it back!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Help me get it back!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Pleassssseeeeeee. Have you ever heard of a fall from grace? Well I'm plummeting from the tippy top of the needle point sky scraper currently gutting the CLOUDS!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleassssseeeeeee. Have you ever heard of a fall from grace? Well I'm plummeting from the tippy top of the needle point sky scraper currently gutting the CLOUDS!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: What's there to think about?! We belong at the top and there's only one way to get back there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's there to think about?! We belong at the top and there's only one way to get back there.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: It's all about burning shit into peoples' brains. Ok? Not literally. Intention isn't to catch a DQ on leveling off someone. Let's do it right. Post these shimmer flyers around Nivalis, get the buzz going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all about burning shit into peoples' brains. Ok? Not literally. Intention isn't to catch a DQ on leveling off someone. Let's do it right. Post these shimmer flyers around Nivalis, get the buzz going.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I'ma work the airwaves. Drop little hints like beads of sweat on a dance floor. We'll meet back when we're both done and shimmy our way to every private room and VIP lounge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'ma work the airwaves. Drop little hints like beads of sweat on a dance floor. We'll meet back when we're both done and shimmy our way to every private room and VIP lounge.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Ask me again sometime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ask me again sometime.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are the Club Rat Kids?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are the Club Rat Kids?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who are the Club Rat Kids?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who are the Club Rat Kids?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Said he needs to think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Said he needs to think about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Said he needs to think about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Said he needs to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Reputation. All about it and you don't have it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Reputation. All about it and you don't have it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Reputation. All about it and you don't have it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Reputation. All about it and you don't have it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Couldn't. Don't know your reputation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Couldn't. Don't know your reputation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want me to do about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want me to do about it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want me to do about it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want me to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time to do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time to do that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time to do that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time to do that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry. Hope you land in the sea and not on plasteel!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry. Hope you land in the sea and not on plasteel!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry. Hope you land in the sea and not on plasteel!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry. Hope you land in the sea and not on plasteel!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He said something about your reputation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He said something about your reputation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He said something about your reputation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He said something about your reputation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. What do you want me to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. What do you want me to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine. What do you want me to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine. What do you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you going to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you going to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just that something happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just that something happened.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And it's yours, not mine, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it's yours, not mine, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And it's yours, not mine, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And it's yours, not mine, right?
